title: Prompt Injection Vulnerability of Consensus Generating Applications in Digital Democracy
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith/religion. The study focused on the vulnerability of LLMs to prompt injection attacks in the context of generating consensus statements on public policy questions.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the analysis.
